name: OutCut: Video Editor
summary:
OutCut is an intuitive VR video editor that brings cutting, trimming, and arranging footage into an immersive workspace. Import videos from your device’s media gallery, work naturally with your hands, and shape your project in a calm, distraction-free environment.

Save and load projects at any time. When you're done, export the final edit straight back to your device for quick uploads to YouTube, Google Drive and more

OutCut is actively being developed, with regular updates and new features on the way.
